# Læsø

Læsø is a Danish municipality (kommune) that appears in the AFDK (Atrieflimren i Danmark) program as part of the health cluster "Klynge NORD" [^src1]. The mention occurs within a chapter documenting Indicator 8 (Structured Patient Education), which includes a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters participating in the AFDK program [^src1].

Læsø is mentioned once in the corpus, listed under Klynge NORD alongside the region's structured patient education indicator reporting [^src1]. No further details — such as specific data, outcomes, or relationships involving Læsø — are available in the source material.
